# v1.0.0 — Production Book Translation, Layout-Preserving EPUB & Collaborative Agent Engine

The first production-ready `1.0.0` release of **d-transcreate-skill**. This milestone turns the skill pack into a zero-config, end-to-end book translation and transcreation engine across all major agent runtimes — combining deterministic `.pdf`/`.epub` ingestion, byte-exact EPUB layout preservation, modular `d-research` context intelligence, persistent cross-book terminology memory, live multi-agent Peer Cross-Check, and strict anti-omission QA enforcement.

---

## Highlights

- **Zero-Config Deterministic Book Pipeline (`scripts/book_ops.py`).**
  A complete Python 3.8+ standard-library CLI (`init`, `convert`, `scan`, `sync-glossary`, `verify`, `merge`) handles full-length books, technical manuals, fiction, and policy volumes in `.epub`, `.pdf`, `.md`, `.txt`, and `.html` formats. Built-in CJK tokenization and multilingual chapter recognition (`Chapter`, `Chương`, `Hồi`, `Quyển`, `第…章/回/卷/節/話`) split oversized volumes cleanly at chapter and paragraph boundaries with zero mid-paragraph breaks.
- **Layout-Preserving EPUB Mode (`.epub` → `.epub`).**
  When translating an `.epub` book back to `.epub`, `scan` archives `.source-template.epub` and maps every chunk to exact XHTML DOM leaf-block coordinates (`epub_href`, `epub_block_start`, `epub_block_end`). During `merge`, `book_ops.py` injects translated text directly into the original DOM containers while preserving 100% of stylesheets (CSS), fonts, cover art, ornaments/SVG assets, OPF manifest/spine structure, and layout classes (`<section>`, `<div class="header-box">`, `<p class="dropcap">`, scene dividers) byte-for-byte — updating only translated text, `<title>`, localized `toc.ncx` / `nav.xhtml` entries, and OPF `<dc:language>` metadata.
- **Smart PDF Ingestion & Format Conversion (`.pdf` → `.txt` / `.epub`).**
  Multi-tier PDF extraction automatically probes PyMuPDF (`fitz`), `pdfplumber`, `pdfminer.six`, `pypdf`, `pdftotext`, and a built-in pure-stdlib FlateDecode PDF parser fallback. Extracted pages undergo running header/footer removal, page-number stripping, and hard-wrapped paragraph reflow to produce clean `.txt` and structured `.epub` working copies before translation.
- **Modular `d-research` Pre-Translation Engine (`core/workflows/d-research-module.md`).**
  Three-tier module discovery (`<pack_root>/modules/d-research/`, sibling `d-research` skill, or self-contained internal fallback) produces a durable `research-dossier.md` in Phase 3 via two structured tracks:
  - **Track A (Existing Prior Translations):** harvests established names, titles, signature idioms, and reader-flagged pitfalls from prior editions.
  - **Track B (Untranslated Works):** establishes historical/cultural background, authorial intent, stylistic register ladder, and a concrete **Transcreation Mindset Compass**.
- **Two-Tier Persistent Shared Glossary & Vietnamese Localization Profile.**
  - **Tier-1 Cross-Book Memory (`memory/glossary-vi.csv`)** stores vetted domain/cultural/narrative terms across projects and automatically seeds new workspaces (`book_ops.py init` / `sync-glossary --seed`), with `--promote` promoting approved high-confidence project terms back into persistent memory after QA.
  - **Tier-2 Live Inter-Agent Sync (`glossary-inbox.jsonl`)** synchronizes recurring terminology proposals from parallel workers between waves and detects conflicting definitions before dispatch continues.
  - **`core/locales/vi-VN.md`** provides a complete Vietnamese book localization standard covering kinship/pronoun matrices, Sino-Vietnamese vs. vernacular register balance, loanword handling, dialogue punctuation styles, and number/date formatting.
- **Runtime Auto-Detection & Mandatory Peer Cross-Check (`core/workflows/subagents.md`).**
  Automatically detects Native Swarm (shared message board), Subagent Spawner, or Sequential fallback without runtime lock-in. Dispatched chunks must pass independent peer verification by `Continuity Reviewer` and `Fidelity Reviewer` before any chunk can transition to `done`.
- **Zero-Tolerance Completeness & Anti-Truncation Gate (`book_ops.py verify`).**
  Enforces 100% `chunk-manifest.csv` coverage, word/character/paragraph/heading parity, placeholder/omission detection (`[omitted]`, `[truncated]`, unresolved task markers), unclosed code-fence detection, and strict glossary compliance before `merge` is permitted.

## Added

- **`scripts/book_ops.py`** — Deterministic 6-subcommand CLI (`init`, `convert`, `scan`, `sync-glossary`, `verify`, `merge`) with pure-stdlib PDF/EPUB parsing, Layout-Preserving EPUB rebuild engine, CJK-safe parity checks, and clean `.txt`/`.epub`/`.md` assembly.
- **Modular research workflow & contracts** — `core/workflows/d-research-module.md`, `core/schemas/research-dossier.md`, and `templates/research-dossier.md`.
- **Cross-book memory & locale profile** — `memory/glossary-vi.csv`, `memory/README.md`, and `core/locales/vi-VN.md`.
- **Antigravity native adapter & module bundling** — `adapters/antigravity/` (`SKILL.md`, `AGENTS.md`) and `--with-d-research` support in `scripts/build_adapters.py`.
- **Release-gating validators C21–C23** in `scripts/validate_pack.py` verifying modular research dossier contracts, persistent shared memory & glossary sync integrity, and deterministic book-pipeline parity/adapter readiness.
- **Eight new end-to-end integration tests** in `tests/test_pack.py` (33 total tests) covering full `.epub` layout preservation, `.pdf` → `.txt`/`.epub` conversion, CJK scanning, two-tier glossary promotion, strict anti-truncation checks, and `antigravity` adapter packaging.

## Changed

- **`scripts/build_adapters.py`** now packages `memory/`, `templates/`, and `scripts/book_ops.py` into every target build (`portable`, `antigravity`, `claude-code`, `codex`, `cursor`, `opencode`, `generic`) so installed skills execute `book_ops.py` out of the box.
- **`.github/workflows/validate.yml` & `.github/workflows/release.yml`** now byte-compile `scripts/book_ops.py` and validate all seven adapter platforms including `antigravity`.
- **All canonical documentation, role prompts, schemas, and example seed artifacts** updated to `1.0.0`.

## Quick Start (Zero-Config Book Mode)

Install for your agent runtime (example for Antigravity with modular `d-research`):

```bash
python3 scripts/build_adapters.py \
  --platform antigravity \
  --dest ~/.gemini/config/skills/d-transcreate \
  --with-d-research ~/.gemini/config/skills/d-research-skill \
  --force
```

Translate a full `.epub` or `.pdf` book into any target language:

```bash
# 1. Initialize workspace & seed Tier-1 glossary
python3 scripts/book_ops.py init --source book.epub --target-lang vi --workspace ./book-ws

# 2. Scan chapters cleanly (preserves DOM/layout map for .epub, converts .pdf to .txt/.epub)
python3 scripts/book_ops.py scan --source book.epub --workspace ./book-ws --max-words 1500

# 3. Synchronize shared terms between research/translation waves
python3 scripts/book_ops.py sync-glossary --workspace ./book-ws --seed --target-lang vi

# 4. Run zero-omission, parity & glossary checks after Peer Cross-Check
python3 scripts/book_ops.py verify --workspace ./book-ws --strict

# 5. Merge final deliverables (preserves original CSS/images/layout for .epub -> .epub)
python3 scripts/book_ops.py merge --workspace ./book-ws --out book_vi.epub --format both
```

---

## Upgrade Notes

- Existing `0.5.x` / `0.6.x` adapter installations should be rebuilt with `--force` so `memory/`, `templates/`, `scripts/book_ops.py`, and the modular `d-research` workflow are installed cleanly alongside `core/`.
- Note that CI workflows and release packaging require `VERSION` (`1.0.0`), `core/d-transcreate.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, and `scripts/book_ops.py` to remain aligned.
